questions.q: Which Tailed Beast is sealed inside Naruto?
questions.why: Kurama, the Nine-Tailed Fox, is sealed inside him.
Kakashi is Team 7's leader, and the team includes Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura.

questions.q: Which village leader title does Naruto dream of earning?
questions.why: Naruto becomes the Seventh Hokage by the end of the story.

questions.q: Naruto learns the Rasengan while traveling with which mentor?
questions.why: Jiraiya teaches him the Rasengan during their journey.

questions.q: Which Leaf Village leader was Naruto's father?
questions.why: Minato, the Fourth Hokage, is Naruto's father.

questions.q: In what year did the Naruto series begin in Weekly Shōnen Jump?
Which studio produced the Naruto TV anime?
questions.why: Pierrot produced it with Aniplex, and it premiered in 2002.

questions.q: In what magazine did the Naruto one-shot appear in 1997?
questions.why: The one-shot appeared in the summer 1997 issue of Akamaru Jump.
Junko Takeuchi voices Naruto in Japanese and Maile Flanagan in English.

questions.q: An early one-shot idea that never made it to print had Naruto working as what?
questions.why: Kishimoto once planned a one-shot starring Naruto as a chef, but that version was never printed.
